items.title: MECH-021: is the subjective now a horizon-integrating control surface?
items.note: IGW-20260917-242 / EVB-1393 / EXP-0759. First experimental evidence for MECH-021 (0 prior runs, 0 autopsies, re-derive brake count 0). GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout is the anticipatory-restraint fraction under a theta-window / rollout-depth contrast; reanalysis_query over all 1044 recorded manifests returns 0 carrying it, the single manifest holding theta_buffer_size (v3_exq_876a, MECH-025) pins it at 10 as a constant rather than sweeping it, and v3_exq_105_rollout_horizon_sweep is MECH-135 on a goal-proximity DV with no harm-term readout and no flat manifest in the corpus -- not recoverable, so this runs. COMMITMENT-FREE BY CONSTRUCTION: the DV is read off the PRE-SAMPLING E3 harm term with APPROACH/RECEDE labelled from grid geometry, never from harm_eval, so it is neither circular nor routed through committed-action conversion. The claim's 'realised harm falls' clause DOES run through that conversion face (f_dominance_conversion_ceiling, implementation_status wontfix), so it is kept as a measured but NON-load-bearing C3: a conversion failure records as 'mixed', never as a vacuous refutation of MECH-021. red-team (opus): BLOCKING on first pass -- 2 BLOCKING + 6 CONTESTED. The Fable spawn hit a model spend limit; re-spawned once inheriting the session model per the skill. All 8 verified against source; 7 fixed, 1 declared. Load-bearing ones: an un-instrumented C2 was being written to disk as MECH-021's FALSIFYING branch (measurability is now a precondition of scoring, not a criterion); C3 counted 'hazard_approach', which under use_proxy_fields fires on proximity WITHOUT contact and whose per-episode rate is satisfied by dying sooner (now contacts per 100 steps); eval-env hazards were drifting every 5 steps INSIDE the D=30 scoring horizon that defines the ground-truth label (drift pinned off); the readiness gate ranged over all 5 actions while the criterion reads only the approach/recede subsets (gate is now that contrast). Declared not fixed: theta_buffer_size also sizes the deque behind ThetaBuffer.recent that agent._do_replay consumes, so the arms differ in replay depth too -- C1 and C2 are immune (both within-tick reads; C2 never uses ARM_WIN1), it bears only on C3. Full dispositions in the module docstring. Eval runs at num_hazards=3 while the warm-up trains at 1: a declared, arm-symmetric shift that preserves cross-arm comparability but not comparability to warm-up-config numbers. Smoke PASS (--dry-run, end-to-end, z_goal stream live). A starved in-band sample self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue / unknown, never 'weakens'.
